g.text: Disease, cell preparation, IFN-β duration and assay differ
between the cohorts at once, so the sign difference cannot be
attributed to any single factor. Stimulated monocyte − NK levels
were similar in both cohorts; the gap arose mainly in untreated-
cell baselines. HIRISA interval is descriptive.
Opposite to the predicted decrease. Smallest attainable two-sided p = 0.25.
Separate cohort: 3 healthy donors, mixed PBMC, 1,000 U/mL.
